asr.full_text: back in the nineteen nineties most people hadn't heard of Microsoft or Apple however they both went on to become two of the largest companies in the world and virtually everyone in the world knows their name he took Microsoft nearly nine years to turn over 1 billion dollars in revenue it took Apple nearly seven years to accomplish that feat what most people today do not know though is that recently a new company became the fastest growing ever in history it achieved a turnover of one billion dollars in just 12 months and amazingly just three months later achieved two billion dollars most people in the world have not heard of this company but those who have are about to experience massive financial benefits over the coming years those who are in the know are holders of something so special that in just a few years from now people all over the world will want what they have and be willing to pay huge amounts of money for them who is this company and what do those involved have now that will become so precious very soon the company is called one coin and those involved are the owners of the new digital currency that is set to become the number one cryptocurrency in the world. bitcoin started back in 2019 and no one took any notice. people thought it was a scam. it took nearly 3 years before bitcoin was on the open market and began trading. it went from $0.10 a coin to over $1200 a coin at the end of 2013. those weren't bitcoins bitcoins made fortunes Bitcoin has a maximum of 21 million coins it combined Today around fifteen point five million coins have been mine one coin will mine a total of 2.1 billion coins Today around six hundred and twenty000 coins have been mined. Once 70-80% of OneCoins has been mined, it will also go live on the market for anyone to purchase and use. When that happens the price of OneCoins will truly explode and those people who own them are going to experience the same wealth like never before. One of the major benefits for owners of OneCoin is the fact they cannot be stolen. Each coin has its own DNA, so if any coins were stolen, they can be traced and returned to the owner. The downside with nearly all other digital currencies is that this is not the case as we saw with Bitcoin a few years ago when someone stole hundreds of thousands and some people lost fortunes because of it History shows us that companies that bring major changes to our world are soon overtaken and left behind is better More advanced companies step in and take over. Bitcoin is the founder of Cryptocurrency but over the next few years, Onecoin is set to raise the standards and become the number 1 Cryptocurrency globally. Business owners, lawyers, doctors and ordinary people all over the world are gradually understanding the fact that cryptocurrency is not just here to stay but it will one day be the major payment platform for every single person in the world those people who get involved today invest a little of their money and join our mining community are the ones who will literally be laughing all the way to the bank in a year or two from now. Our education packages will teach you exactly what cryptocurrency, is how to invest in poor economic times and of course how to trade with cryptocurrency and increase your wealth. Do you want to be the holder of a cryptocurrency that will be in hot demand within a few years do you want to benefit financially and maybe even be able to retire in a few years from now if so then take the time to learn about one coin and discover why so many people like yourself are now moving into the fastest growing trend worldwide hindsight is great but foresight is life changing.

textual.observation: The source promotes OneCoin ownership by claiming future demand, large price appreciation, and major financial benefits for holders.

evidence.quote: those who have are about to experience massive financial benefits over the coming years
people all over the world will want what they have and be willing to pay huge amounts of money for them
When that happens the price of OneCoins will truly explode and those people who own them are going to experience the same wealth like never before.

textual.context: Promotional context presenting anticipated financial outcomes. The outcomes are framed as future expectations tied to OneCoin reaching the market.
textual.potential_relevance: The cited future wealth and price-explosion claims are connected to owning OneCoin before the stated market-launch condition, creating an observable reward-and-timing relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish future market demand, price, returns, or whether any holder realized the described benefits.

textual.observation: Viewers are encouraged to invest money and join a mining community based on a claim that early participants will profit substantially within one or two years.

evidence.quote: those people who get involved today invest a little of their money and join our mining community are the ones who will literally be laughing all the way to the bank in a year or two from now.

textual.context: Promotional call to action. The requested investment and community participation are explicitly linked to a suggested financial outcome and timeframe.
textual.potential_relevance: The source directly links investing money and joining the mining community today with substantial financial benefit in a year or two, which is a concrete action-to-return relationship requiring later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The amount to invest, payment recipient, enrollment process, fees, contractual terms, risks, and actual results are not provided.

textual.observation: The description invites enrollment to profit from OneCoin, although the enrollment instruction is truncated.

evidence.quote: How to profit from One Coin, the Crypto-Currency global leader. To enroll, get ...

textual.context: Apparently promotional description, but the destination or next enrollment step is unavailable because the text ends after the displayed truncation marker.
textual.potential_relevance: A profit claim is directly followed by an enrollment request, creating an observable benefit-to-action relationship, while the incomplete instruction requires later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not show what viewers must get, where they must enroll, what enrollment costs, or what destination was intended.

textual.observation: The source encourages viewers to learn about OneCoin and become holders by suggesting they could benefit financially and possibly retire within a few years.

evidence.quote: Do you want to be the holder of a cryptocurrency that will be in hot demand within a few years do you want to benefit financially and maybe even be able to retire in a few years from now if so then take the time to learn about one coin

textual.context: Promotional rhetorical questions and call to learn more. The retirement outcome is qualified with "maybe" rather than stated as certain.
textual.potential_relevance: The cited passage connects learning about and becoming a holder of OneCoin with anticipated financial benefit and possible retirement within a stated multi-year timeframe.
textual.limitations: No specific acquisition step, contribution amount, probability, return calculation, or substantiation for the retirement suggestion is supplied.

textual.observation: The source claims OneCoin cannot be stolen because each coin can be traced and returned to its owner.

evidence.quote: One of the major benefits for owners of OneCoin is the fact they cannot be stolen. Each coin has its own DNA, so if any coins were stolen, they can be traced and returned to the owner.

textual.context: Promotional security and ownership-benefit claim used to contrast OneCoin with other digital currencies.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed protection from theft is presented as a major ownership benefit alongside invitations to invest and become a holder, linking an asserted safeguard to the promoted financial participation.
textual.limitations: The records do not explain the technology, custody model, recovery process, exceptions, independent support, or whether any coins were actually traced and returned.

textual.observation: The source compares OneCoin with Bitcoin's reported historical appreciation and says OneCoin owners will experience the same wealth.

evidence.quote: it went from $0.10 a coin to over $1200 a coin at the end of 2013.
those people who own them are going to experience the same wealth like never before.

textual.context: Promotional comparison to Bitcoin. The ASR contains potentially erroneous or garbled wording elsewhere in the comparison, including dates and coin references.
textual.potential_relevance: The cited historical price comparison is used to frame an analogous wealth outcome for OneCoin owners, creating a comparative return claim relevant to later assessment of how viewers are induced to participate.
textual.limitations: The source records do not substantiate the historical figures, demonstrate that OneCoin is comparable to Bitcoin, or establish that equivalent appreciation will occur.

visual.observation: A branded OneCoin presentation states that the coin rose from 10 cents to over $1200 per coin, says owners will experience unprecedented wealth and may be able to retire within a few years, and asks viewers whether they want to benefit financially.
visual.context: Promotional presentation context is visible through OneCoin branding, the slogan "THE BEST OR NOTHING," the phrase "JOIN THE FINANCIAL REVOLUTION," and Millionaires United branding.
visual.potential_relevance: The presentation links a substantial financial and retirement outcome to an audience-directed invitation to benefit from the branded coin, making the claimed return and implied participation relevant for review.
visual.limitations: These frames do not show a specific purchase, enrollment, transfer, contact method, payment step, or other concrete action required to obtain the stated benefits. The claims, identity, and outcome are not independently verified from the sampled frames.
